Agent Name: Orchestrator
, Step Number: 35
, Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator’s “Updated Fact Sheet” incorrectly claimed the $99 2025 Gold Pass included unlimited 2024 season access and parking, when the page only indicated 2025 unlimited visits and limited 2024 event access (e.g., WinterFest/Tricks and Treats). This faulty assumption misframed the price comparison for June–September 2024 and led the process toward an incorrect basis, contributing to the wrong final answer.
